purpose: Comparison evidence for public distribution guidance; Marketplace API/feed readback is retained separately and does not resolve owner-side approval state.

githubRelease.name: Nagi for JetBrains IDEs 0.1.2
githubRelease.assetReadback: Public GitHub release API returned the non-draft, non-prerelease tagged release and common ZIP + SHA256 assets. Following the public ZIP URL through GitHub release-assets returned HTTP 200 on HEAD; following the checksum URL returned HTTP 200 and the listed 91-byte SHA256 sidecar. Any temporary signed redirect URLs were excluded from stored evidence.

marketplaceReadback.observation: Public endpoints showed only 0.1.1 in the versions list and product feeds, while exact user-reported update ID 1189900 returned 404; the permalink served a generic client shell. This does not establish owner-side approval state or retract the user-reported 0.1.2 approval notification.
marketplaceReadback.guidance: Marketplace instructions should link to the existing listing and direct users to its Versions view to check available versions and compatible IDE builds. Do not claim 0.1.2 is currently obtainable from Marketplace or infer 0.1.3 approval.

docsDecision: Keep verified GitHub Release jetbrains-v0.1.2 asset/version/build facts. Make only exact Marketplace version-availability wording version-neutral; retain 0.1.3 as unreleased candidate.
